translations.text: As I swore in my anger, “They shall not enter my rest.”
When it is said, “Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion.”
And we will do this if God permits.
We have this as a firm and immovable anchor for our souls, which also enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain.
Now see how great this man was, to whom even the patriarch Abraham gave a tenth of the spoils.

Those of the sons of Levi who receive the priesthood have a commandment under the law to collect a tenth from the people, that is, from their own brothers, although they too have come from the loins of Abraham.
He says above, “You were not pleased with and did not desire sacrifices, offerings, burnt offerings, and offerings for sin,” which were offered according to the law.
By faith Joseph, at his death, spoke of the departure of the sons of Israel and gave instructions concerning his own bones.
Endure discipline; God deals with you as sons. What son is there whom his father does not discipline?
Do not forget to do good and to share, for God is pleased with such sacrifices.
May he strengthen you in good works to do his will, and may he work in us what is pleasing in his sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever. Amen.
